steps.text: Moment of a force = force × perpendicular distance from the pivot.
Equilibrium: resultant force is zero and clockwise moments equal anticlockwise moments.
Pressure P = F/A; in a fluid P = ρgh.
Upthrust equals the weight of displaced fluid: ρ_fluid g V_submerged.
Floating: upthrust equals the object's weight, so only part of the object is submerged.
